highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers the Skia m151 engine update with faster managed color, shaping, and pixel operations.
highlights_body: It also improves WebAssembly support, fixes native resource lifetime issues, and adds zero-copy shaping results for text-heavy applications.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer advances to Chrome milestone 151 with subsequent upstream correction merges.
Text shaping can read glyph results through spans, avoiding unnecessary managed copies.
SKImage creation from encoded data with a subset no longer leaks its native resource.

bullets.lead: Common color operations run in managed code
bullets.detail: Color conversion, premultiplication, tag parsing, and hex parsing avoid recurring interop and allocation overhead.
WASM native libraries and validation are updated for current .NET preview exception-handling support.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly build cleanup, managed color optimization, and HarfBuzzSharp performance work

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate completed performance, shaping, and resource-lifetime improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added managed hot-path optimizations, shaping spans, and WebAssembly improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the line with the Skia m151 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp improves UTF-8 input handling, tag parsing, and zero-copy shaped-glyph access.
